text: Bronze, Silver, and Gold are live, along with Kafka -- but nothing checks any of it automatically. This video wires two gates into GitHub Actions so a broken pull request never reaches main.

Gate one tests the real PySpark logic with pytest against a local Spark session. Gate two runs terraform plan under a read-only service principal -- apply stays a separate, human step. Both are required checks.
The function that decides a package's current status is importable now, not buried in a notebook cell -- the same code runs in the test and on the real cluster.
Notice what's missing from the Terraform job: no apply step, anywhere. CI can only compute a plan and report it.
Every change is tested automatically now. Next: scheduling the pipeline, and giving support a live lookup from Fabric.
